# vappcloud_iam_policy_attachment (Resource)

Attaches an IAM policy to exactly one principal, group, or role. All attachment identity fields are immutable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vappcloud_iam_policy_attachment" "operators_readonly_vmm" {
  policy_id   = vappcloud_iam_policy.readonly_vmm.id
  target_type = "group"
  target_id   = vappcloud_iam_group.operators.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_id` (String) Policy ID.
- `target_id` (String) Target principal, group, or role ID.
- `target_type` (String) Attachment target type: `principal`, `group`, or `role`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Attachment timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `created_by` (String) Principal that created the attachment.
- `id` (String) Opaque public resource identifier.
- `policy_arn` (String) Attached policy ARN.
- `policy_name` (String) Attached policy name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vappcloud_iam_policy_attachment.operators_readonly_vmm policy-id/group/group-id
```
